## Summary

Extracted two private helpers around the percentile-reflection logic:

- **`configurePercentileQuantile(double p)`** — pulled out of `getPercentile`. Owns the reflective `setQuantile` call and translates `NoSuchMethodException`/`IllegalAccessException`/`InvocationTargetException` into `MathIllegalStateException`/`IllegalStateException` as before.
- **`validateSetQuantileSupport(UnivariateStatistic impl)`** — pulled out of `setPercentileImpl`. Probes the candidate impl with `50.0d` and translates the same three reflective failures into `MathIllegalArgumentException`/`IllegalArgumentException`.

Both helpers sit next to the existing `invokeSetQuantile` so all reflection logic is grouped. `getPercentile` shrinks from ~20 lines to 7, and `setPercentileImpl` shrinks from ~17 lines to 4 — each now reads as a high-level statement of intent. Behavior, exception types, exception messages, public APIs, and Java 6/7 compatibility are unchanged.
